name: SimuLatte
creative_worldview: Cozy craft, warmly lit. SimuLatte is the neighborhood cafe where every cup is made by hand, so each frame is tactile and unhurried: real ceramic, real steam, warm morning light raking across an oak counter. The mood is generous and human - the comfort of a slow first sip, never slick or corporate. Photography feels like a warm documentary moment inside a beloved coffee shop.
brief: Campaign: SimuLatte, a modern artisan coffee shop known for hand-pulled espresso and latte art. Palette lock: espresso brown, warm caramel, oat-milk cream; golden morning light only. Style: warm tactile lifestyle and product photography, shallow depth of field, one hero subject per frame, cozy and premium.
logo_prompt: Design the official brand logo for 'SimuLatte', a modern artisan coffee shop. A clean friendly mark of a coffee cup with a subtle rising-steam swirl, with the wordmark 'SimuLatte' beneath it. Palette: warm caramel and espresso-brown mark, deep coffee-brown text, on a completely flat solid pure-white background. Clean vector style, centered, generous margins, no photography, no extra text.
no_text_instruction: Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, wordmarks, watermarks, buttons, or UI elements anywhere in the image.
